components.name: Chapter link
components.description: Native chapter access with a scene index, chapter name, verb, and current-state accent.
components.css: .ds-chapter { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px auto; padding: 20px 12px 12px 0; min-height: 64px; font-family: var(--font-plex-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono'), monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; color: #97938b; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms; } .ds-chapter > span:first-child { font-size: 9px; padding-top: 1px; } .ds-chapter em { grid-column: 2; font-style: normal; margin-top: 7px; font-size: 10px; color: #97938b; } .ds-chapter[aria-current], .ds-chapter:hover { color: var(--ink, #e8e6e3); } .ds-chapter[aria-current] > span:first-child { color: var(--accent, #e8a33d); } .ds-chapter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #e8a33d); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-chapter { transition: none; } }

components.name: About link
components.description: A restrained header anchor with an amber hover and shared focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-about { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-plex-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono'), monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--ink, #e8e6e3); padding: 12px 0 12px 12px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-about:hover { color: var(--accent, #e8a33d); } .ds-about:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #e8a33d); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Reading link
components.description: Underlined document-flow replay and original-exhibition links.
components.css: .ds-reading-link { display: inline-block; padding: 12px 0; color: var(--ink, #e8e6e3); font-family: var(--font-newsreader, 'Newsreader'), Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 5px; text-decoration-color: #5c5850; } .ds-reading-link:hover { color: var(--accent, #e8a33d); } .ds-reading-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #e8a33d); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
This document records the implemented `/v2` route. It supplements the shared `design.md` and `VISUAL_SYSTEM.md`; it does not replace their authority or prescribe a new identity for other routes. The implementation is a five-act local release candidate, with an editorial title, an authored mechanical world, and a semantic reading room.

One photograph remains recognizable as its representation changes from terminal data to a spatial archive, a touch surface, contextual memory, and a final image without surrounding controls. Near-black space, warm machine light, and two typographic voices connect the acts. Native scrolling advances the exhibition; chapter links jump directly to authored resting states.
keyCharacteristics: A persistent photographic subject across three fidelity representations.
Newsreader for human statements; IBM Plex Mono for machine evidence and navigation.
A pinned composition with deliberate CSS 3D travel and receding chrome.
A separate reading room containing the story and disclosure of authored behavior.

rules.name: The Attention Rule
rules.body: Preserve amber as the established machine and focus signal; do not introduce a competing accent family.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Human statements and outcomes use Newsreader; commands, chapter identification, archive evidence, and controls use IBM Plex Mono.

rules.name: The Shared World Rule
rules.body: Keep the photograph and its transforming frame in the same spatial continuity; depth expresses a change in operation rather than a new page or disconnected spectacle.

dos: Do preserve the dark/amber palette and the two established typographic voices.
Do keep the same photographic subject recognizable across fidelity changes and transformations.
Do preserve scene indices, chapter identification, native anchor access, and visible keyboard focus.
Do retain the semantic reading room and disclosure of generated imagery and authored behavior.
Do use the compact and reduced-motion layouts when extending the route.
donts: Don't replace the pinned cinematic composition with a generic card grid.
Don't turn the terminal's machine glyphs into unrelated decorative particles.
Don't treat per-scene coordinates, camera poses, or terminal illustration text sizes as global reusable tokens.
Don't invent live inference, background tasks, or interactive controls for the authored demonstrations.
